pr_title: Implement ADR 0117 project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_body: Follow-up for ADR 0117: fix the lifecycle lock OpenOptions Clippy failure, remove the Editor's legacy in-process New/Open Project rebinding paths, route dirty-guarded project switching through the Launcher, remove startup project rebinding and duplicated Editor-side scaffold policy, and add lifecycle control regression tests. Re-run full Windows validation.
